xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
Note 1 :
As per Indian Accounting Standard 108 on ‘Operating Segment’ (Ind-AS 108), the Group has reported "Segment information", as described below:
Scientific – Laboratory Glass & equipment and Process System:- Comprising of items used in laboratories, production floor and research and development and filter paper.
Primary Pharma Packaging :- Comprising of Tabular Vials and Ampoules used as Primary Pharma Packaging material in Pharmaceutical Companies.
Consumer Glassware:- Comprising of Consumer glassware items.
Unallocated:- Consists of income, expenses, assets and liabilities which can not be directly identified to any of the above segments.
Note 2 :
During the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, in view of the expansion of the Consumer Glassware business, the internal reporting structure has been changed so that the Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM) reviews the performance of Consumer Glassware separately for allocating resources and assessing performance. Consequently, the Group has re-assessed and realigned its operating segments in accordance with Ind AS 108 "Operating Segments". Accordingly, the segments of the Group, which were earlier reported as (a) Scientific – Laboratory Glass & Equipment and Process System, (b) Glassware and (c) Others, are now reported as (a) Scientific – Laboratory Glass & Equipment and Process System, (b) Primary Pharma Packaging and (c) Consumer Glassware. In accordance with paragraph 29 of Ind AS 108, the segment information for the corresponding previous periods / year has been restated, and the figures have been rearranged / reclassified to conform to the revised segment structure.
